ONBOARDING PROCESS

Typical steps.

01

Intro & fit

Confirm services, geographies of interest and commercial model.

02

Contacts

Exchange escalation owners, branding rules and reporting format.

03

Paperwork

Discuss NDA, MSA, SOW, SLA, DPA or insurance evidence when applicable.

04

First work order

Pilot a clearly scoped visit or project before wider volume.

WHITE-LABEL OPERATIONS

Communication and control.

Partners keep the customer relationship unless a work order says otherwise. HeyDock follows partner branding and communication rules agreed in writing. Scope changes require partner approval. Reporting and escalation paths are named per work order.

DOCUMENTS AND INSURANCE

What can be discussed.

An NDA, master services agreement, statement of work, service levels, data-processing terms or insurance evidence can be discussed or shared privately when applicable to a partnership. This website does not imply that any specific document or insurance certificate already exists or is available for public download unless a verified file is linked from Documents & policies.
